item.description: When neighbors are informed, communities thrive. item.title: Feds investigating cause of gas line explosion that leveled house
item.description: All six people injured in a gas line explosion and fire that leveled at least one home in unincorporated Alameda County on Thursday are in stable condition, authorities said. item.title: Criminal case dropped against former police officer in 2020 fatal shooting
item.description: An Alameda County judge on Friday agreed to dismiss a case against former San Leandro police officer Jason Fletcher, who was charged with voluntary manslaughter in the fatal shooting of Steven Taylor five years ago. item.title: Livermore Valley Arts reports ‘strong’ financial health following year of deficit-spending
item.description: Despite operating in the red last fiscal year, Livermore Valley Arts is doing well financially with an operating reserve of over $1.3 million, according to CEO Chris Carter and the nonprofit organization’s annual report to the City Council. item.title: LVJUSD, teachers union reach tentative agreement after marathon mediation day
item.description: Livermore school district and teachers union negotiators agreed to terms that would end their impasse late Friday night, with a deal centered around two salary increases during the 2026 calendar year and additional health and welfare benefits.
